name: Travel Advisory API
tagline: Country travel risk scores for trip safety checks.
description: Public API providing aggregated country travel risk scores (0-5 scale) based on official government travel advisories, primarily useful for trip safety checks and travel risk assessment.

auth.details: No authentication required for public endpoints.

use_cases: get travel risk score for a country by ISO code
check if a destination is high-risk before booking
compare risk levels across multiple countries
